summary: This note is a short biographical entry for Neil Edward Hopkins, an American television and film actor born May 13, 1977. It describes him as a trained actor and singer. It is best known for playing Liam, the heroin-addicted brother of Charlie, on the television series Lost.
one_line: Neil Edward Hopkins is an American television and film actor and singer, best known for playing Liam on Lost.
